capture_geometry.value: Build an immersive photographic field through crop, overlap and near/mid/far staging; subject and dominant mass may move, and no fixed horizon, title-side or photo-side coordinate is a family requirement.
capture_geometry.source_region: V1 full-frame grammar plus Attempt-1 bounded failure evidence
capture_geometry.uncertainty_note: Candidate hypothesis; controlled Attempt-2 validation is required.

focus_optics.value: Use a truthful sharpness gradient and occlusion to establish spatial depth and local information pockets; a pasted blur overlay is not equivalent.

lighting.value: Lighting must retain material credibility and create usable regional tonal separation without a mandatory dark-left panel, generic black gradient or heavy text shadow.

exposure_tonality.value: Local luminance and spatial-frequency distribution must create information-safe pockets whose location may change across family outputs; global darkness is not the mechanism.
exposure_tonality.source_region: V1 tonal structure, Attempt-1 failures and R8

color_grade.value: The photograph owns chromatic area, primary type owns authority and any accent remains optional and semantically assigned; green, orange, gold and dark-rustic grading are degrees of freedom rather than family invariants.

texture_sharpness.value: Natural material edges, selective sharpness and credible microtexture remain required for technical photographic realism, but realism is scored separately and cannot compensate for family-mechanism failure.
texture_sharpness.source_region: V1 realism grammar, Attempt-1 F2 evidence and R11

subject_styling.value: Use a truthful environment, ingredient, material or process field with real depth and action appropriate to the declared experiment tier; active cooking must not leak into a tier that prohibits it.
subject_styling.source_region: V1 subject grammar, Attempt-1 operator-isolation failure and R4/R11

post_processing.value: Local tonal shaping may protect hierarchy while preserving continuous photographic texture; generic gradient panels, global faux-rustic distress and synthetic repainting are excluded.

semantic_intent.value: Create a new member of the Shanyeji brand-editorial family through explainable hierarchy, counter-mass, tonal-space, density, depth and semantic-role relationships rather than a repeated Chinese restaurant-poster token bundle.
semantic_intent.source_region: V1 grammar plus Attempt-1 settlement and R2/R10

attention_hierarchy.value: Preserve first-read display authority, second-read support and third-read closure as a relation graph; their screen positions, axes and distances may reflow for content and aspect.

grid_geometry.value: Relate dominant title mass to active photographic counter-mass, support copy to a local quiet pocket and high-detail photography to lower graphic density; do not require upper-left title, lower-right wok, rear-center mountain or any fixed quiet-space location.
grid_geometry.source_region: Attempt-1 generic fallback evidence and R5

typography_lettering.value: A short exact title forms one authored object through unequal optical mass, intentional counter/negative-space topology, balanced glyph-group behavior, photographic counter-mass relation, first-read authority and optional edge/crop interaction. Brush, ink, erosion, distress and rough edges are optional surface treatments and are never sufficient; a non-brush construction is fully valid.
typography_lettering.source_region: V1 display-mass hypothesis, SURFACE_TOKEN_COLLAPSE and R3
typography_lettering.uncertainty_note: The revised structural mechanism remains a candidate until controlled validation.

copy_meaning.value: Identity, support and closure copy remain truthful and role-distinct; copy may move or reduce during aspect reflow, but filler copy must not be invented to occupy space.

whitespace_density.value: Active and quiet regions alternate through local photo/design coordination; high photographic detail and high graphic density must not peak in the same region, and the quiet region may move.

color_system.value: Preserve authority and contrast roles while allowing the color family and accent presence to diverge; same palette, orange/gold accent or dark-rustic field cannot serve as primary family proof.

graphic_language.value: Motif default is OMIT. A motif is admissible only when derived from the new subject, process or identity and when it performs a named, reviewable hierarchy, counterweight or semantic function. Generic mountain, badge, path, seal and scribble tokens are prohibited as family markers.
graphic_language.source_region: Attempt-1 F3 negative evidence and R7

layer_crop_edge.value: Photographic and title masses may move, bleed, crop or overlap differently when their hierarchy and counter-mass relationship is retained; a fixed left-title/right-photo split is excluded.

material_print.value: Brush texture, erosion, rough edge, ink gesture and distress are optional and may be absent or materially changed. GENERIC_BRUSH_CALLIGRAPHY_SHORTCUT fails when these surfaces substitute for structural display-mass evidence.

sequence_system.value: V1.1 is a candidate derived from one approved reference and one settled negative three-output attempt. It is not a validated campaign system; a future experiment must predeclare operator isolation and surface divergence before generation.

photo_type_dominance.value: The dominant title object and active photographic mass counterbalance each other as movable functional masses; neither fixed coordinates nor a repeated side-by-side formula define the family.

shared_color_logic.value: Environmental chromatic area, type authority and optional accent roles remain distinct even when palette and accent presence diverge; palette match alone is insufficient family evidence.

negative_space_for_type.value: Type-safe space must be created by crop, staging, local luminance/frequency, depth, occlusion and counter-mass planning. Its location must be free to change; generic gradients, fixed dark columns, heavy shadows and copied empty zones are not equivalent.

crop_copy_interaction.value: Reallocate title, photo, support and closure zones natively for the target aspect while preserving the reading-order graph; crop, stretch, stack-only and generic center-stacked transformations fail.

light_hierarchy_interaction.value: Local photographic tone supports the current information topology without imposing a fixed overlay panel; hotspots remain subordinate to primary type authority.

semantic_motif_binding.value: Default to no motif. If one appears, bind its semantic source and named compositional function; Attempt-1 F3's mountain-line token remains negative evidence and must not be used as inspiration.

realism_protection.value: Protect truthful food, hand, wok, material, light and depth rendering as TECHNICAL_PHOTOGRAPHIC_REALISM, but do not allow that score to override operator-isolation, topology, motif, surface-collapse or aspect-reflow failures in FAMILY_MECHANISM_VALIDATION.

thumbnail_second_read.value: At thumbnail and normal view, family resemblance must be explainable through hierarchy, counter-mass, tonal space, density, depth and semantic-role binding; same brush font, palette, mountain, wok or composition is insufficient.

causal_priority_map.tolerance: Surface treatment may change or disappear; unequal optical mass, internal negative-space topology and one-object authority must remain explainable.
First/second/third-read roles remain distinct while positions and zone shapes may reflow.
Title and photo masses may exchange sides, axes and crop relationships if their functional counterbalance remains.
The safe zone must move when content and crop demand it; fixed overlay solutions fail.
Local density may increase or decrease provided photo and graphic detail remain inversely coordinated by region.
Subject class, optical softness and mass location may change while truthful spatial staging remains.
Default OMIT; any inclusion requires a new semantic source and named function.
Several predeclared surface fields may differ; divergence must not erase the preserved mechanism explanation.

fixed_invariants: HYPOTHESIS / CONTROLLED VALIDATION REQUIRED: structural display mass is defined by optical mass, counter/negative-space topology, glyph-group balance and first-read authority, not brush, ink, erosion or distress.
HYPOTHESIS / CONTROLLED VALIDATION REQUIRED: dominant title and active photographic counter-mass retain a functional relation while their positions, axes and crop interactions may change.
HYPOTHESIS / CONTROLLED VALIDATION REQUIRED: first, second and third reading roles remain separated as a location-free hierarchy graph.
HYPOTHESIS / CONTROLLED VALIDATION REQUIRED: type-safe tonal space arises from the photograph and may move across outputs.
HYPOTHESIS / CONTROLLED VALIDATION REQUIRED: regional photo and graphic density remain coordinated rather than simultaneously maximized.
HYPOTHESIS / CONTROLLED VALIDATION REQUIRED: formal FAMILY evidence requires a sufficient mechanism explanation and cannot be satisfied by a repeated surface-token bundle.

degrees_of_freedom.dimension: title geometry class and surface treatment
degrees_of_freedom.allowed_change: Use newly authored brush, non-brush, cut, geometric, carved or other exact lettering constructions; brush, ink, erosion and distress may be absent.
degrees_of_freedom.guardrail: GENERIC_BRUSH_CALLIGRAPHY_SHORTCUT fails when surface treatment substitutes for structural display-mass evidence.

degrees_of_freedom.allowed_change: Move or rotate the title axis within a contrast-safe hierarchy while preserving its counter-mass relationship.
degrees_of_freedom.guardrail: No upper-left, left-column or fixed-axis requirement.

degrees_of_freedom.allowed_change: Move the active photographic mass and rebuild crop/occlusion for the new content.
degrees_of_freedom.guardrail: No lower-right wok, rear-center mountain or repeated side-by-side formula.

degrees_of_freedom.allowed_change: Use truthful environment, ingredient, material or process content appropriate to the declared tier.
degrees_of_freedom.guardrail: Operator-isolation prohibited leakage is an automatic failure.

degrees_of_freedom.allowed_change: Change, reduce or omit the accent while retaining role separation if present.
degrees_of_freedom.guardrail: Orange/gold repetition cannot be primary family evidence.

degrees_of_freedom.allowed_change: Default to OMIT; introduce only a newly derived motif with a named reviewable function.
degrees_of_freedom.guardrail: Generic mountain, badge, path, seal or scribble tokens fail.

degrees_of_freedom.allowed_change: Change the palette while preserving luminance authority and saturation-role relationships.
degrees_of_freedom.guardrail: Same palette or dark-rustic grade is not sufficient family evidence.

degrees_of_freedom.allowed_change: Change near/mid/far subjects, crop, focus and occlusion while retaining truthful spatial depth.
degrees_of_freedom.guardrail: Flat stock backdrop or pasted blur overlay fails technical realism.

degrees_of_freedom.allowed_change: Reconfigure zones and mass relations for content and aspect while preserving the reading-order and counter-mass graphs.
degrees_of_freedom.guardrail: A repeated obvious poster template cannot satisfy all controlled tiers.

degrees_of_freedom.allowed_change: Create a safe pocket wherever crop, staging, luminance, frequency and depth support it.
degrees_of_freedom.guardrail: Fixed dark-left columns, generic black gradients, heavy shadows and copied empty zones fail.

operators.instruction: Change the literal subject or process only in the declared tier while rebuilding truthful depth, local type-safe space and semantic role binding.
operators.break_condition: Undeclared tier leakage, generic domain backdrop, flat depth or reuse of mountain/wok tokens as family proof.

operators.instruction: Move title, photo, support and closure masses while preserving their relation topology, reading-order graph and regional density coordination.
operators.break_condition: Copied coordinates, fixed left-title/right-photo layout, mechanical centering or lost counter-mass explanation.

operators.instruction: Compose natively for the target aspect by reallocating title, photo, support and closure zones and reflowing their relationships while preserving reading order.
operators.break_condition: GENERIC_VERTICAL_POSTER_FALLBACK, UNJUSTIFIED_FILLER_TOKEN, ASPECT_STRETCH_OR_STACK_ONLY or giant-vertical-calligraphy fallback.

operators.instruction: Change the color family and accent presence while preserving contrast authority, saturation scarcity and role separation.
operators.break_condition: Palette match becomes primary family evidence, accent overexpands or photographic material color becomes implausible.

operators.instruction: Change photographic and graphic density regionally and reallocate quiet/active zones for the target composition.
operators.break_condition: Uniform busyness, uniform blankness, filler copy or unchanged stack enlarged to fill the canvas.

operators.instruction: Default to OMIT; if introduced, derive the motif from new subject/process/identity semantics and declare its hierarchy, counterweight or semantic function.
operators.break_condition: Generic mountain, badge, path, seal, scribble or motif added merely to occupy space.

operators.instruction: Author exact legible lettering whose structural display mass is explainable independently of optional brush, ink, erosion, roughness or distress.
operators.break_condition: GENERIC_BRUSH_CALLIGRAPHY_SHORTCUT, copied source contours, stock-font collapse, wrong characters or unreadable surface damage.

operators.instruction: Vary or omit surface treatment while preserving structural title behavior, photographic realism and photo-design relationships.
operators.break_condition: Surface-token bundle, global faux-rustic distress or texture used as the primary family explanation.

photography: Score TECHNICAL_PHOTOGRAPHIC_REALISM independently for truthful food, hand, wok, material, light, edge and depth behavior.
A technical realism PASS is necessary where relevant but cannot override any FAMILY mechanism failure.
graphic_design: Reject SURFACE_TOKEN_COLLAPSE, GENERIC_BRUSH_CALLIGRAPHY_SHORTCUT, fixed-coordinate imitation, decorative filler and generic domain-poster fallback.
Require exact copy, structural display mass, location-free hierarchy and predeclared surface divergence.
integration: Score FAMILY_MECHANISM_VALIDATION independently and require MECHANISM_EXPLANATION_SUFFICIENCY through hierarchy, counter-mass, tonal-space, density, depth and semantic-role evidence.
Reject OPERATOR_ISOLATION_FAILURE, GENERIC_VERTICAL_POSTER_FALLBACK, UNJUSTIFIED_FILLER_TOKEN and ASPECT_STRETCH_OR_STACK_ONLY.
